name: Riskiest Assumption Test (RAT) Decomposition
phase: Hypothesis Framing and Assumption Mapping Tactics
hypothesis: We believe that [Assumption A] represents the single existential bottleneck for the business model. We will verify this by decomposing the business concept into causal dependency trees, and consider it validated if breaking this single assumption mathematically invalidates all downstream unit economics.

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Take the top-ranked assumption from the DFV matrix and break it into discrete component premises.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Build a causal tree of what must be true and trace back to the premise whose failure collapses it.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Write the test specification for that root: thresholds, time boundaries and required evidence weight.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Isolate the top-ranked assumption from the DFV matrix. Break it down into discrete component premises.

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Construct a causal dependency tree using "What Must Be True" statements. Trace dependencies backward to identify the foundational premise whose failure collapses the entire structure.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Draft a dedicated testing specification for this root assumption, detailing validation thresholds, temporal boundaries, and required evidence weights.

warning.label: Premature Optimization of Secondary Assumptions
warning.text: Teams test easy details - interface polish, onboarding copy - while skipping the existential risk.

warningFull: Teams frequently expend energy testing easily measurable operational details (such as interface aesthetics or onboarding micro-copy) while sidestepping existential commercial viability risks.
